messages:
pagerbot: [INCIDENT] p95 latency & 502 spike observed on prod-canary (alert INC-2026-834). Auto-pager triggered.

samir: paging oncall @maria @alex — looks correlated with the recent smallpatch deploy (2026-03-17 tokenizer tweak).

maria: yup seeing consistent 502s from canary-3. Stack traces show allocator/tokenizer blowup on long inputs.

alex: can confirm logs: repeated OOM in tokenization path. rolling a quick mitigation.

samir: plan: 1) toggle safemode FF -> kill new tokenizer path on canary 2) revert single commit if toggle doesn't stop errors 3) notify CS.

alex: running: `/ff toggle safe_tokenizer_v2 false --env prod-canary --by alex`

pagerbot: Action executed: safe_tokenizer_v2 set to false by alex.

lina: prepping revert: `git revert 7a4d2b1 --no-edit && ./ci/deploy --canary` — will kick in in ~4m.

ashley: heads up CS: small cohort affected (~0.4% requests hitting canary). severity low->medium, some long-input customers affected. drafting status update.

maria: tail of canary logs: ```ERROR TokenizerOOM: allocation failed at 1.2GB
stack: tokenizer::process -> kv_cache::reserve -> allocator::alloc```

alex: after FF toggle, error rate dropped from 6% -> 1.1% within 90s. still seeing intermittent 502s. continuing revert.

samir: if revert completes and errors drop, we'll keep safemode off for full rollout until PR with guard landed.

lina: revert landed, canary deploy started. smoke runs: `curl -sS https://canary.internal/health | jq .` -> healthy.

ashley: posted status on status.redwood.ai: "Partial impact: short-term 502s for small set of requests. Mitigation in progress." CS synced with top 3 affected customers.

maria: metrics: p95 latency back to baseline, error rate ~0.2%. logs preserved at s3://redwood-ops/incidents/6198642000/logs.tar.gz

alex: spinning a quick patch branch with input-length guard + unit test: github.com/redwood/pr/2984. won't roll until QA signoff.

samir: assign followups in tracker: 1) bisect commit 7a4d2b1 root cause (eng-ml) 2) add long-input e2e & unit tests (eng-runtime) 3) tighten canary traffic split & autoscaling thresholds (eng-sre).

ashley: CS will send a follow-up message to impacted customers with summary and ETA for permanent fix.

lina: reverting deploy verification complete across canary nodes. no regression observed in dedicated/private.

pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-834 resolved by lina at 6198642240 :white_check_mark:

samir: great job everyone. I'll create the postmortem draft and include the preserved logs/ff toggles/deploy timeline. Closing thread once PM completed.
